question: What discharge capacities do the Mn-substituted LNO cathodes with 10% and with 50% Mn deliver?
rendered: The Mn-substituted LNO cathodes with 10% Mn deliver a discharge capacity of 212 mAh g−1, while the ones with 50% Mn deliver a discharge capacity of 164 mAh g−1.
